Armoured kraken: An advanced safespot exists on the rocks east of Buccaneers' Haven using earth magic.

The angling of the boat is very important for this method, and the margin of error for the safe spot is thin, as you need to be close enough to keep the Kraken under water using the nose of your boat, but not too close so that you aggro two at once.
Hammerhead shark: Sharks just east of Corsair Cove are able to be safespotted on boat from across the rock formations they spawn amongst, making them ideal for reducing damage taken on bounty tasks.
Also, can be safespotted on land at southern most point below Equa leaves spawn below start location of Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest.
Stingray: Stingrays west of the Colossal Wyrm Remains can be safespotted across many of the nearby rock formations, and they can not deal damage to boats with an adamant keel or better.
Veiled kraken: A safespot exists for veiled krakens as shown by the picture below.
This allows players to kill veiled krakens without ever being attacked, although this will only attract the spawn south-west of the safespot as the others will be too far.

Entering the safespot from the south will aggro a nearby great white shark, but it can't attack into the safespot; entering from the north will rarely aggro the krakens, but if they do then they can attack into the safespot.
The safespot will allow players to loot the kraken's corpse without having to move out of the spot.
